column3: The Hebrew explicitly mentions Shishak’s hand as the means; BSB says through Shishak.
The Hebrew says they will know “my service and the service of the kingdoms of the lands”; BSB explicitly frames this as learning the difference and refers to kings.
The Hebrew says “the king’s house”; BSB specifies “the royal palace.”
The Hebrew calls these men “runners” and says “the king’s house”; BSB says “guard” and “royal palace.”
The Hebrew says the runners came and carried them; BSB explicitly adds “with him” and identifies the objects as shields.
The Hebrew leaves him unnamed here and says there were good things in Judah; BSB names Rehoboam and describes conditions as good.
The Hebrew explicitly says he strengthened himself and reigned in Jerusalem; BSB combines this as establishing himself there.
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here; BSB names Rehoboam.
